/// The suffix of every `docsUrl` (ADR 0026 §6).

/// Whether two byte strings are equal, in a `const fn`.
const fn bytes_eq(a: &[u8], b: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if a.len() != b.len() {
        return false;
    }
    let (mut a, mut b) = (a, b);
    while let ([x, a_rest @ ..], [y, b_rest @ ..]) = (a, b) {
        if *x != *y {
            return false;
        }
        a = a_rest;
        b = b_rest;
    }
    true
}
